<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Bypoll schedule:</strong> The Election Commission of India has announced that by-elections for five Assembly seats and one Lok Sabha constituency (Nagaon, Assam) will be held on October 6, with results expected on October 9.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQaE9UTTJEazdFQS1hVDVLb2JzOHdfaFdmNEFad1ZoTEU4M2ZUX0NuQWpGYmVNak10TUJPd2l5Z3BUY3hpTGZYZFZLVnVVUGRHYzRlOS00RTZLNUI5RkNZY1lxa0RuMW1UZXVRTmFPcU8tLTVnendEc2hCSVJ3a2h3aWZtVldNS01GMDZVcUJ6V0xuTnk0ZjEtYlc2MlNqaWNyeXJ4c19YMDBoSXNJcm9r?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha nominations:</strong> The BJP has officially announced its candidates for nine Rajya Sabha seats spanning six different states.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNaVhocTRXcTFZVHNGTHZRVEYyZXBfM0VIa0wzbUNUaGJjRS0zeEV6akpHUmxOMmhyaHRMNERTWW4td2hkMW8zcUZnR1poMllnUnJ1YjYycEZ4T052T2p6YjhRell2R1RHU0doVHo0d1AtdGE2dHBhM3dheUVwcUZtRmRDU3B6UDdKSnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court is set to hear petitions regarding the marital rape exception on September 9, while also permitting the West Bengal government to file a report concerning the questioning of Abhishek Banerjee’s personal assistant in a land-grab probe.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative gridlock:</strong> The Congress party has accused the government of keeping the Monsoon Session on &quot;ventilator&quot; to secure a two-thirds majority for upcoming Delimitation Bills, citing the unusual delay in proroguing Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary updates:</strong> Parliament has passed the Transgender Persons Amendment Bill, 2026, while the Lok Sabha continues budget discussions amidst the Speaker’s absence pending the resolution of a no-confidence motion.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
